meta.name: minimalist-ui
meta.description: Clean editorial-style interfaces. Warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels. No gradients, no heavy shadows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建干净、编辑风格的界面设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要简洁、温暖、无阴影的界面风格。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clean, warm, shadowless interface style.

howto.what: 当Claude被要求生成网页界面或前端代码时,它会按极简编辑风产出:暖色调黑白灰、衬线标题、扁平bento网格、柔和粉彩点缀,并避免渐变、重阴影、通用字体图标和表情符号。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude编写前端代码或设计界面布局时触发,尤其是提到“极简”“编辑风”“bento网格”等关键词时。

say.text: 帮我做一个极简编辑风格的落地页,用暖色黑白灰和衬线标题。
say.note: Claude会生成对应风格的页面代码。

say.text: 给这个页面套用极简UI规范:去掉渐变和重阴影,改用1px边框与扁平卡片。
设计一个bento网格功能区,用柔和粉彩标签,不要圆角大按钮。
say.note: Claude会产出对应的网格布局。

howto.what_en: When generating web interfaces or frontend code, Claude follows a minimalist editorial style: warm monochrome palette, serif headings, flat bento grids, muted pastel accents. It avoids gradients, heavy shadows, common generic fonts/icons, and emojis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write frontend code or design a layout, especially if you mention keywords like minimal, editorial, or bento grid.

say_en.text: Create a minimalist editorial landing page with a warm monochrome palette and serif headings.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the page with that style.

say_en.text: Design a bento grid feature section with muted pastel tags, no oversized rounded buttons.
say_en.note: Claude will output the matching grid layout.
